notes: Site: beruru.com (Shopify). Tier-1 direct HTTP fetch used throughout, no block encountered (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow). Checked: (1) full collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 98 handles) - grepped case-insensitively for clearance/outlet/final/last-chance/end-of-line/discontinu*, zero matches; the only sale-adjacent handle present is /collections/offers. (2) Direct URL probing of common Clearance handles - /collections/sale, /collections/clearance, /collections/outlet, /collections/final-sale, /collections/last-chance, /collections/end-of-line - all returned HTTP 404 (do not exist as collections). (3) Homepage + campaign-page main-nav/body link scan - no Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance wording found in any collection link. (4) Pages sitemap surfaced two sale-named PAGES (not collections/PLPs): /pages/annual-root-to-roof-sale (h1 'Annual: Root-To-Roof Sale Terms' - a terms-and-conditions page for a recurring seasonal/physical sale event, no product grid) and /pages/wh-sale-2026 (h1 'Warehouse Sale 2026' - an editorial/campaign announcement page, no product listing on the page itself, no distinct product collection linked from it beyond the site's normal nav). Both are seasonal promotional campaign pages, not permanent clearance/outlet merchandising, and neither is a PLP - excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule and the PLP-only rule. (5) /collections/offers was opened: h1 'Offers', but it is a generic, unlabeled 'Offers' page (not Clearance/Outlet/Final-Clearance/Last-Chance/End-of-Line wording) containing only 1 product (Verdure Pot) - matches the brief's explicit exclusion for generic offers pages; excluded, not flagged as ambiguous since it carries no clearance/outlet framing at all, only a generic sale-adjacent label. (6) Shopify's own predictive-search API (/search/suggest.json, resources[type]=collection) for the queries 'clearance', 'outlet', 'sale', and 'final sale' each returned an empty collections array (resources.results.collections: []) - Shopify's own search layer confirms no collection matches these terms. The product-level fuzzy matches returned by the same queries (e.g. 233 'hits' for 'clearance') are loose token matches against unrelated product tags like 'Sale2023'/'Sale Feb 2024'/'TablesAnnualsalebackorder2026' (seasonal-campaign tag noise), not evidence of a genuine clearance listing - confirmed by inspecting the actual product titles/tags returned, none of which represent a clearance/outlet merchandising concept. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance-type PLP exists on this site as of this pass.
